name: jackal-strategy
description: JACKAL — First Jump pyramider. FOX v1.6's exact five-layer entry gauntlet combined with RHINO's pyramiding mechanic. Enter at 30% on a qualifying First Jump, add 40% at +10% ROE and final 30% at +20% ROE — but only after re-validating 4h trend, SM alignment, and volume. Failed scouts cost $15 instead of FOX's $50. Full pyramids capture the same upside. DSL High Water Mode (mandatory).
